Top 40 topics (Chalisa) till June 2026
1. Donald Trump Attack on Iran and Venezuela
2. Donald Trump`s Dream to Annex Greenland and ending up as G2 with China
3. G7 Summit and FATF
4. India USA relationship
5. WTO Summit and head reappointed
6. Gaza Peace Plan of Trump
7. UAE`s Exit from OPEC (OIC,GAFTA and Five Eye)
8. Mother of All Trade Deals
9. Pax Silica and India`s Semiconductor Mission
10. Pakistan and Afghanistan War Broke Out
11. Shiekh Haseena will return to Bangladesh
12. India Nepal relationship
13. Awards and Honours
14. VanDyke Arrest and India`s relationship with Myanmar
15. India Canada Relationship Revamped
16. UN high Sea Treaty
17. AI Impact Summit
18. India Withdraw as Host from COP
19. India Japan Summit
20. Modi Ji`s Visit to 5 Nations
21. Important days ( 20 days)
22. Census and Delimitation
23. VBGRAM G replaced MGNREGA
24. NEW CDS of India
25. PMs of India and their Achievements
26. India Achieved criticality and Shanti BILL and IAEA INS Aridhnam
27. 131st Constitutional amendment Bill.
28. Finance Commission of India and Fiscal Policy
29. Supreme court strength Increased (Women`s in SC for AILET)
30. Election in State Assemblies of India
31. Parliamentary Privileges
32. Environment and Climate change
33. Women ODI and T20 World Cup
34. Men`s T 20 World Cup and IPL
35. Football World Cup
36. Artemis II Mission
37. World happiness Index , World Hunger Report , Press Freedom index.

38. QUAD and SCO balance by India
   39. BRICS Summit in India
   40. Commemorative days – Emergency RSS and Kakori



CLAT Chalisa for Fun to remember all the Topics

CLAT Chalisa 2027 (Memory Version)

Jai CLAT Mata, gyaan ki dhaara,
Current affairs ban jaaye hamara sahaara.

Trump ne Iran par nazar jamaayi,
Venezuela ki kahaani bhi saamne aayi.

Greenland sapna, G2 ki baat,
China ke sang badli siyaasat ki chaal.

G7 baitha, FATF bhi aaya,
Global finance ne sabko samjhaaya.

India-USA dosti gehri hui,
Trade aur defence mein pragati hui.

WTO ka summit phir se chhaya,
Chief ne dobara pad bhi paaya.

Trump ka Gaza Peace Plan yaad,
West Asia bana charcha ka vishay.

UAE ne OPEC ko chhoda ek din,
OIC, GAFTA, Five Eyes bhi rakho mann mein.

Mother of All Trade Deals ka dhyaan,
FTA, CEPA sab rakho pehchaan.

Pax Silica ka yug hai aaya,
Semiconductor Mission ne Bharat chamkaaya.

Pakistan-Afghanistan seema jali,
Border politics phir se chali.

Sheikh Hasina ki ghar waapsi ki baat,
Bangladesh bana exam ka prashn saath.

Nepal sang Bharat ke rishte nyaare,
Border, power aur sanskritik dhaare.

Padma, Nobel, Bharat Ratna ka maan,
Awards yaad rakho subah-shaam.

VanDyke arrest hua Myanmar ke paas,
India ki Act East bani khaas.

Canada se rishte phir muskuraaye,
Diplomacy ne naye rang dikhaaye.

High Seas Treaty samundar bachaye,
Marine biodiversity ko aage badhaaye.

AI Impact Summit ka sandesh,
Technology badlegi duniya ka vesh.

COP ki mejbaani Bharat ne chhodi,
Climate diplomacy ne nayi raah jodi.

Japan sang summit hua shaan se,
Bullet train se Indo-Pacific pehchaan se.

Paanch deshon ka Modi ne kiya daura,
Foreign policy ka badha gaurav saara.

Important Days yaad kar lena,
Har ek date ko note kar lena.

Census aur Delimitation aaya,
Loktantra ka naya adhyay samjhaaya.

VBGRAM-G ne li MGNREGA ki jagah,
Rural reforms ki bani nayi raah.

Naya CDS sena ka neta,
Joint commands ka bada chehra.

Pradhan Mantri sab yaad banaao,
Unke yogdaan bhi saath padhaao.

Criticality ka Bharat ne paaya maan,
IAEA aur INS Arihant ki pehchaan.

131st Amendment yaad rakhna,
Samvidhaan se kabhi na hatna.

Finance Commission aur Fiscal Policy,
Budget, tax aur economy ki philosophy.

Supreme Court ki badhi shakti,
Mahila judges bhi bani vishesh bhakti.

Rajya chunav ka rakho gyaan,
Loktantra ki yahi pehchaan.

Parliamentary Privileges ka adhikaar,
Sansad ka sammaan apaar.

Climate change aur environment saath,
Net Zero banega bhavishya ka path.

Women's ODI aur T20 ka rang,
Champions likhenge itihaas ke sang.

Men's T20 aur IPL ki baat,
Sports GK ka yahi hai saath.

Football World Cup ka junoon,
Goal ke saath yaad karo poora soon.

Artemis-II chala antariksh ki ore,
Moon Mission khole naye dwaar aur.

Happiness, Hunger, Press ki list,
Rankings se bante CLAT ke twists.

QUAD aur SCO dono nibhaaye,
India strategic balance dikhaaye.

BRICS Summit Bharat mein aaye,
Global South ki awaaz badhaaye.

Emergency, RSS aur Kakori yaad,
History-current ka banta saath.

Jo vidyarthi roz ise gaaye,
Current affairs kabhi na bhool paaye.

CLAT mein uska naam chamke,
NLU ke sapne sach ho jaaye.
